surat.headline: Textile sector faces input-cost and labor stress, while diamond cluster sees operational rebound

Widespread labor unrest emerged across weaving, embroidery, and general textile units with protests over hours, leave disputes, and an early Diwali exodus.
The diamond industry reported a demand resurgence, shortening Diwali vacations for the first time in four years and creating momentum to reverse previous wage cuts.
